description.value: StillFood Bistro is an artisan coffee and fresh-fare restaurant on Front Street in downtown Penticton, a well-positioned stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan. The bistro emphasizes vegan-friendly options alongside its cappuccino bar, making it a solid refuelling choice for riders with dietary restrictions. Penticton's Front Street sits near the waterfront and multi-use paths connecting Okanagan and Skaha lakes.
